intuition: For each value, the only useful partner is its complement (`target - value`). Remember values already seen so each pair can be found in one pass.

brute_force.approach: Try every pair of indices and return the first pair whose values sum to the target.

optimal.approach: Scan once while mapping each value to its index. Check for the complement before recording the current value so an element is never paired with itself.

edge_cases: Duplicate values can form the answer; check the complement before inserting the current value.
Negative values and a negative target work with the same complement calculation.
